node.statement: For a unital Banach algebra A and ||Z-I_A||<1, H=sum_{m>=0}c_m(Z-I_A)^m converges absolutely in norm; absolute convergence permits the same Cauchy products as the scalar identity, giving ZH^2=I_A, and the normalization H=I_A+terms of positive degree identifies H with the analytic branch Z^(-1/2) used by the registered power-series functional calculus.
